rubric.name: Hackathon judging
rubric.description: Four criteria, judged once by Jev; the aggregation decides the winner.
rubric.context:
You judge one hackathon entry from its write-up. Judge each criterion on its own: a strong entry can still score
low on one criterion. Most entries land in the middle.

evidence.label: common-room.md
evidence.text:
# Common Room (fictional hackathon entry)
A shared calendar for student housing: book the laundry room, the kitchen and quiet hours without a group chat.
Booking works in a demo, but there are no reminders or sign-in yet and it has rough edges. Shared calendars
exist; the new angle is that it's built around one house and its house rules. A real annoyance for students in
shared housing.
